For four marked points, only positivity of cyclic gaps is observable in one remaining move; for three, gap lengths truncated at 3 suffice, and for two, truncation at 7 suffices. Independent exhaustive full atomic checks (all three unordered pairings of each marked quartet, not just one) distinguished n=1,…,15 and found n=15 and 16 identical. They also established T2(6,7)=T2(7,7); the 7-gap reduction then proves the all-n>=15 tail from the seven possible pair types. IMPORTANT: the supplied separation_rank5_verify.py includes only one matching per four-subset, not the full four-ary atomic signature. Its printed certificate alone is therefore insufficient; I independently used the full matching signatures and obtained the same decisive values. The mathematical proof itself uses the complete relation.
